lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured lattice of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four visible horizontal rows and at least six vertical columns across the central flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity approximately perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, intersecting with the circular blobs to form a regular grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel across the upper flank, each characterized by a sharp high-to-low vertical luminance gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower right quadrant exhibits a significantly higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter of high-luminance blobs compared to the lateral flank patterning.
